text:
[NVIDIA | 10-K | FY2025 | Item 7 MD&A | Gross Margin]

Gross margin increased to 75.0% in fiscal year 2025 from 72.7% a year ago, primarily driven by a higher mix of Data Center revenue. Inventory provisions and the cost of Hopper and Blackwell ramps partially offset the increase.

[NVIDIA | 10-K | FY2025 | Item 7 MD&A | Research and Development]

Research and development expenses increased 49% in fiscal year 2025, driven by compensation and benefits, including stock-based compensation, reflecting employee growth, and by compute and infrastructure costs.
header: [NVIDIA | 10-K | FY2025 | Item 7 MD&A | Research and Development]

text:
[NVIDIA | 10-K | FY2025 | Item 1A Risk Factors | Competition could adversely impact our market share and financial results]

Our target markets remain competitive, and competition may intensify with expanding and changing product and service offerings, industry standards, customer needs, new entrants and consolidations.
